_doc: Shear samples of the DES/DECADE run. Paths in 'large_inputs' refer to keys of config/large_inputs.json (staged outside git); 'data/...' paths are relative to Projects/des_decade_run. Per mock: one row of the paired n(z)/m realisations (DESY6 mdet, BFD), or the mean n(z) with Gaussian dz and m (DECADE). 2026-11-06.

nz_m.note: row k gives n(z) (nzs[k]) and m (ms[:, k]); dz = 0. Final mdet product (confirmed by user 2026-11-06)

catalogue.previous: cat_BFD (full light catalogue, ml estimator; until 2026-11-20)

nz_m.note: 20k random rows of the 633,514 BFD-calibrated SOMPZ realisations (nonneg GLS calibration, 2026-11-06); include photo-z and calibration uncertainty; dz = 0

estimator.doc: 2026-11-20: g_p = -(1/N_p) Rbar^-1 Q_p, Rbar = global full-catalogue response (meta Rbar_code_sign, unrotated), fixed mask N_p >= 3 (N3 catalogue), unit shear response, exact noise variance V cR/N^2, analytic SC normalisation; lam = full-catalogue expected counts from the mask file. sc_calibration is NOT used (ml-estimator specific).

nz_m.note: DECADE cosmic shear, arXiv:2509.03582 Table 1 (first column NGC, second SGC; NGC/SGC assignment as in the previous mock script)

DECADE cosmic shear, arXiv:2509.03582 Table 1 (first column NGC, second SGC; NGC/SGC assignment as in the previous mock script). The previous script had m_sigma bin 2 = 0.004657 (typo for 0.00657) and rounded dz_sigma.
